objective: Generate high-precision local counterfactual repairs for later 4-BPE localization, without reading any QA correctness annotation.

aligned_candidate_rules.proper_name_rule: both sides multi-token proper names or all-cap acronyms

qc.decision: A clear item is a grammatical, single-local-slot repair for which the displayed source makes the replacement locally plausible. It need not pass NLI yet.

stop_rule: Stop before NLI if any capacity condition fails, or if research-agent proxy QC is clearly below 0.80. Proxy QC is never called human review.
next_stage_if_passed: Write a resumable NLI request manifest and runbook only; do not start inference while the GPU is occupied.
version_delta: All six parent types may enter, but every non-citation candidate must independently and uniquely match the exact SequenceMatcher local replace opcode before its frozen type constraints are applied. Capacity and QC gates are unchanged from v2.0.
